results.memory: Likes grilled salmon because it's healthy, quick to prepare, rich in taste, and flaky in texture; finds it satisfying after a long day of coding.
Likes avocado toast as go-to breakfast because it's nutritious, keeps full during long coding sessions, and has creamy texture and fresh taste.
Dislikes fast food burgers because they're too greasy and make feel sluggish, which hinders focus on software development.
Doesn't like large dogs because they require more space and attention than can provide due to busy work schedule.
Likes cats because they're independent and don't require constant attention, suiting lifestyle perfectly.
Likes reading technical manuals because they keep updated on latest coding practices and enhance developer skills.
Dislikes romance novels because they're uninteresting, don't engage analytical side, and prefer intellectually challenging material.
Likes running because it helps clear mind and provides a break from the screen.
Doesn't like team sports because they require coordination with others, which is challenging due to introverted nature.
Likes drinking coffee because it keeps energized and focused during long coding marathons.
Doesn't like drinking soda because high sugar content makes jittery and disrupts concentration.
Likes listening to ambient music because it helps maintain focus and creates calming atmosphere while working.
Doesn't like listening to heavy metal because aggressive sound is distracting and doesn't suit need for peaceful work environment.
